title: SoftBank buys $2B of Intel stock

sources.quote: SoftBank Group Corp. (TOKYO: 9984, “SoftBank”) and Intel Corporation (Nasdaq: INTC) today announced their signing of a definitive securities purchase agreement, under which SoftBank will make a $2 billion investment in Intel common stock.

On August 18, 2025, we entered into an agreement to issue and sell 87 million shares of our common stock to SoftBank Group at $23.00 per share, representing an aggregate cash purchase price of $2.0 billion.

explain: SoftBank bought 87 million new Intel shares at $23 each, giving Intel $2 billion in cash to help fund its chip factories. The sale closed in September 2025.
